verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot supports 'connectors' to a small fixed list of services (OneDrive, Outlook.com, Google Drive, Gmail/Calendar/Contacts) and note these are available on Copilot.com/Mobile, but there is no evidence of a browsable directory/marketplace of third-party apps that power-users can explore and add beyond this short built-in list. missing for 10: evidence of a searchable app/connector marketplace, breadth of third-party (non-Microsoft/Google) integrations, and any independent confirmation of the browsing/add experience.
